[spoiler=Election Day arrives as major electoral schedule changes set to take place.]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Thursday, 29 July 2027[/i]

Election day has arrived as crucial races for Premier and the People's Assembly will be decided after months of campaigning. The states of Kemder and Utveyush will elect new Premiers for the next 4 years, along with each state's respective People's Assembly seats.

In Kemder, incumbent Premier Aleksei Androtevech of the Unity Party is term limited, and was ineligible to run in the race. The frontrunners of the race are Unity candidate Ivan Rometenko and Socialist candidate Kaldangan Kemurtevich. Rometenko is predicted to win with 37% of the vote as opposed to Kemurtevich's projected 28%. In third place, and polling higher than expected, is Karina Lagounov, the candidate for the far-right Reform the State party. She currently has 24% of the vote, but is considered out of the race. The People's Assembly election is expected to play out in a similar manner, albeit with the percent gap between the Unity and the Socialists being reasonably smaller.

In Utveyush, on the other hand, incumbent Socialist Ulyanha Shenchet is easily expected to win, currently projected to win 53% of the vote. The nearest competitor in the race, Toward the Future candidate Petr Kalvyll is only standing at 21% in the polls. The Legislative election is expected to play out in a similar manner, with experts predicting an comfortable, yet important victory for the Socialists, who have been struggling in certain areas as of the past few years due the growing unpopularity of Socialist Prime Minister Danil Sokolova's economic policies.

A change that is happening along with the election is the altering of the election schedule. By convention, certain states had held elections on certain years to ensure that no one year has too many elections. According to the convention, Zhinkena, Rheyara, Torkamy, & Fergecko held elections 1 year after the federal election, Lomeckyj, Behamelt, and Neidyemr held elections 2 years after, and Kemder & Utveyush held elections 1 year before.

As part of a new change announced by PM Sokolova, the election scedule would be officialised, rather than an informal agreement. The new, official scedule will be no different than the original, except that the elections for Fergecko would be moved to the election block currently occupied by Kemder and Utveyush. According to Sokolova "The new schedule is designed to officialise our democratic process, and to more streamline the election cycle and eliminate any confusion that surrounds it".

The Fergeckan elections are to be pushed 2 years ahead of the original expected date, which means that incumbent Fergecko Premier Alik Irentik of the People's Party, who was elected to his 1st term 2 years ago, will have an additional 2 years added to his current term. However, the longer term means that he will be unable to run for a second term. Irentik has criticised the changes, calling them politically motivated and an attempt to prevent him from running for a 2nd term by illegal means, something that Sokolova denies. Sokolova claimed that the changes to the schedule are being implemented to make it more even, and that the fact that Fergecko was the state who's elections were being moved was because of an arbitrary decision by the Electoral Commission. 

The polls opened at 9:00 and will be open until 22:00. The results of the elections will be announced in the following days or weeks, depending on the speed that votes are counted.
[/spoiler]

[u]includes several pov's[/u]
[B]08:34[/b]
[I]the platoon waiting near the bridge look at the distant explosions and turn on the radio. The news is nothing but endless reports of Nueue strikes on home territory until a morse signal goes through.
2 shorts 1 long.
The platoon recognizes the signal. It's time to start
Immediately a few soldiers attach the first naval mine to the bridge, lift it and toss it over the bridge until 13 mines are 2 meter under water hanging from a bridge. Their job is done for now.[/i] 

[I]elsewhere a surface-to-air missile truck is hidden between vegetation waiting for any unfortunate plane to cross its path. Eventually the commander spots a plane on the radar.
"Growler, Turn on home-on-jam!"
The gunner acknowledges and HOJ mode gets turned on, now treating the growler's many electronic distractions as merely a beacon. The SAM unit waits until the growler gets close. 1 missile gets fired and flies straight to the growler, detonating besides it and downing it. The SAM launcher then quickly relocates to an other location to prevent getting striked.[/i] 

[I]across the country regiments and battalions start building trenches and concealing them to blend in with the landscape. At the coast several battalions launch dozens of cheap drones that mimick attack drones. The drones fly towards the HDF fleet and a few engineers watch as several ships try to take down the fake drones[/i] 

[B]Zuidhoven, same time[/b]
[I]major Klaas vuylsteke of the ground army hurried through the corridors of the nearly empty army HQ. He flinches slightly as another missile from the HDF strikes nearby. he walks downstairs to a heavily reinforced bunker and opens the door to see a few other officers who haven't relocated yet. Klaas sits down and starts to speak, "Well...what are our losses?." A few other officers mumble and discuss among themselves until a younger officer speaks up, "we lost a few command centers, a small few of those were decoys, some airfields are heavily damaged and we lost a few planes and some ships on sea but we sunk 2 HDF supply ships. The rest of HDF strikes are in a more detailed document that is almost finished. Thankfully we confirmed that HVLMS Vespurië wasn't sunk. But there is no trace of her, no radio, nothing. Our intelligence says that the HDF also has no idea. The ship just dissappeared. No trace left."
An older officer responds, "Our comms are constantly getting jammed. How do we solve that?" Another officer, this time from the navy looks up, "i got an idea. We will use field telephones for short-medium communication. The growlers can jam elekctromagnetic waves that go through the sky but can't jam them if they go through physical copper wires. That way the jammers are a lot more useless!" Klaas looks at the officer and says, "that seems like a good idea. Copper won't be a problem." Klaas looks at the NCO and says, "tell the engineer battalions to keep planning command center decoys around the country. It must perfectly mimick real ones. And recruit more conscripts. Atleast 70.000 and hold them in reserve." The NCO quickly leaves to deliver the message. 

Klaas sighs and says, "how is the goverment standing around?" Everyone in the room becomes silent and a low-ranking diplomat responds, "well...we have no idea where the ministers went. We estimate that the prime minister, ministers and a few ultranationalist officers are already out the country in unclaimed territory." 

A lieutenant-colonel waves his hand and says,
"i have a plan. How about we fully dissolve the central HQ for the time and fully decentralize the army. That way the army can't be knocked out in 1 strike. But we will keep limited contact in case of an emergency" Everyone in the room starts to think and discuss the proposal. 2 officers at the back then reply, "that sounds pretty decent. But how will they communicate with eachother?"
"The closest battalions and regiments can work together instead of a nationwide communication server." Klaas replied. 

After a few minutes of debate the majority of officers accept the proposal and one captain then blocks the door, "wait, i have a plan."
Officer 1: "what plan do you have?" The captain grabs a document and slides it on the table, "it's daring and high risk and planning, scouting and paying informants will take long but the results will be worth it."
Officer 2: "what are the details?"
Captain: "that is classified but all i can say is that no one will see it coming. Planning is already starting at an undisclosed location and absolute secrecy is required. All i ask for is if the intelligence service can borrow the 1th and 2nd special foreign regiments for the time being."
Klaas looks at the captain and responds, "sure."
The diplomat from earlier then says, "i can look into this and see what NeuDresden demands are for an end to this war. Try to hold out against any attacks until i get a reply back." With that the diplomat leaves and everyone else in the room quickly leaves back to their own regiments and divisions. Several soldiers install in the front lobby several electronic devices that mimick a local command center. Once they are installed the platoon leaves the building on their way to install the next decoy.[/i] 

[B]39 kilometers east from zuidhoven[/b]
[I]a squadron of F-14AN's, divided over three flights, are currently flying at low altitude searching for reconaissance planes, J-15's or EA-18G's. Flight A leader Nicolas look up searching for any traces of a fighter and soon spots a small flight of EA-18G's and J-15's, Nicolas turns on his radio and says, "enemy flight above. Turn on HOJ mode." The pilots turn on HOJ mode on their missiles and pull up, once closer they fire their missiles and the missiles, with HOJ mode on, ignore the decoys the growler sends out and explode under or besides the planes, most planes in the enemy group go down while 2 J-15's try to escape the ambush but 3 planes from flight C intercept them and take them down in a few seconds.
"Good job everyone, let's go" Nicolas and the rest quickly disperse and fly off to hidden airfields they are stationed at. That is the tactic. Fly defensively, lay in ambush, take down reconnaissance planes and growlers and avoid confrontation with the more advanced planes.[/i] 

[B]Near the entrance of the Jacob canal[/b]
[I]it was a boring day for the crew of coastal artillery 280-5. Their only job is to shoot any enemy submarines or ships that try to enter the jacob canal and today seems like that finally will happen.
Sammy, one of the spotters is standing outside with binoculars in hand and scans the horizon. He glances at his watch, 10 minutes until spotter duty rotates to another soldier. He looks back up and sees a Donau-class submarine surfacing to fire off another batch of missiles inland. He pulls the lever besides him and the alarm sounds. Immediately every soldier assigned to 280-5 runs into the turret and starts rotating to the submarine which has already started to fire its missiles, the camouflage that covers the turret starts to fall off because of the rotation. Inside it's a mess of commands and 280mm guided shells loading into the 2 cannons.
"Fire!"
2 shells fly out the cannons and towards the submarine.
One lands besides the submarine,
The second one hits it on top of the bow and causes catastrophic damage. The submarine starts sinking and a few minutes later it lays on the bottom of the canal. 

[B]foreign ministry 
Time: 16:07[/b]
The diplomat from earlier (oliver) is walking through the silent halls, Oliver arrives in the main correspondence room and calls Klaas.
Klaas picks up and says, "who's calling?"
"It's me, Oliver. NeuDresden demands unconditional surrender." Klaas sighs and says, "no way we will surrender until we know their plans after the war." Oliver looks at a message besides him and responds, "i got a message from Metropolis and they want to invite us, Luscaria and NeuDresden to negiotiate about in their words a stable and sustainable peace."
Klaas writes something down and replies, "telegram Metropolis and tell them we will accept their invitation."
Oliver ends the call and starts sending the message to Groldonica via radio.[/i][/spoiler]
